### Load environment

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library("tidyverse")
library("here")
```

### Load data

```{r}
data_dir <- here("data")
clean_df <- readr::read_tsv(file = file.path(data_dir,
                                               "02_dat_clean.tsv.gz"),
                              col_names = TRUE,
                              show_col_types = FALSE)

clinical_clean <- readr::read_tsv(file = file.path(data_dir,
                                               "02_clin_clean.tsv.gz"),
                              col_names = TRUE,
                              show_col_types = FALSE)

sample_map_clean <- readr::read_tsv(file = file.path(data_dir,
                                               "02_sample_map_clean.tsv.gz"),
                              col_names = TRUE,
                              show_col_types = FALSE)
```

#### Construct metadata

We use left_join as this adds additional information (variables) for each observation in the left side dataframe (sample_map_clean) without altering its size. Clinical_clean contains clinical data for all observations in the cohort, whereas sample_map_clean have been filtered to the subset we are investigating.

```{r}
meta_df <- sample_map_clean |> 
  left_join(clinical_clean,
            by = join_by(submitter_id))
```

#### Merge metadata with count matrix

```{r}
augment_df <- clean_df |> 
  left_join(meta_df,
            by = join_by(sample_id))
```

#### Convert TPM counts to log2 expression values

Centers expressions around 0 and allows for easier interpretability of fold changes.

```{r}
augment_df <- augment_df |> 
  mutate(log2_tpm = log2(tpm_unstranded + 1)) |> 
  relocate(log2_tpm, 
           .before = submitter_id)

head(augment_df)
```

### Write data file

```{r}
readr::write_tsv(augment_df,
                 file.path(data_dir,
                           "03_dat_aug.tsv.gz"))
```
